stem_book: A circular platform rotates around a vertical axis with angular velocity of 10 rad/s. On the platform is a ball of mass 1 kg, attached to the axis of the platform by a thin light rod of length 10 cm making angle α = 30° with the platform (see figure). Find the normal force exerted by the ball on the platform (in N). Friction is absent. (Take g = 10 m/s².)
reason: added g = 10 m/s² so the answer is the integer 5
work: T cosα = mω²(ℓ cosα) ⇒ T = mω²ℓ = 1·100·0.1 = 10 N; N = mg − T sinα = 10 − 5 = 5 N
